verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents an API and data platform section that includes a Metrics API v2, query access via the Python and JS/TS SDKs, scores via API/SDK, a public OTLP ingestion endpoint at /api/public/otel, and a CLI for terminal and coding-agent use. Together these show the product can be driven programmatically. The evidence names these capabilities but never shows the API reference itself, and probes of common OpenAPI spec paths returned 404. One hands-on user found the trace retrieval API very slow for bulk scanning and bypassed it by querying the database. Missing for 10: an evidenced API reference or OpenAPI spec, documentation of auth and endpoint coverage for full CRUD control, and bulk-read performance.
